description: Systematic introduction to Lurianic Kabbalah, structured as 138 principles. Complete Kabbalah text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Kabbalah is the Jewish mystical and theosophical tradition. Its works range from short speculative treatises to the multi-volume Zohar, and its language is symbolic rather than propositional.
